title: Forge Co-op
hook: Track S's live co-op room: two to four friends in one torch-lit crypt, each seeing the others' bodies.
prompt: gf-forge track S sandbox (research/rust-engine/PLAN.md §4 S, not a game for anyone yet): the hello room played live by 2-4 players: the host's core owns the world and replays each joiner's inputs, joiners predict and reconcile, each player sees the others as the co-op body in their colour holding their weapon

round.winBy: Explore the crypt: every 3 m you walk scores a point.

rules.summary: Walk the crypt with your friends; every 3 m each of you walks scores you a point.
rules.scoring: +1 for every 3 m walked, counted by the host for every player

characters.describe: you, seen in first person; friends see a hooded body in your colour

content.notes: An empty stone room with a chest.

accept: two players in one crypt, each sees the other's body in their colour with their name
the joiner's walk is immediate on its own screen and where the host has it
each player's own score on the results
